uplink.description: 0-10 V periodic frame: 5.00 V input, input0 closed / input1 open
uplink._note: 0x18 '0-10V' frame. voltage = 0x7D78(32120) * 10 / 64240 = 5.0 V, top-level (a single analog position). logicLevel 0x20 -> bit5. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js postProcessAncienDINDA (voltage.value=5 V, logic_level [1,0]).

uplink.description: 0-10 V periodic frame: 2.50 V input, input0 open / input1 closed (per-position values differ)
uplink._note: 0x18 '0-10V' frame. voltage = 0x3EBC(16060) * 10 / 64240 = 2.5 V. logicLevel 0x10 -> bit4 only, the complement of the vector above. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (voltage.value=2.5 V, logic_level [0,1]).

uplink.description: 0-20 mA periodic frame: 12.00 mA input, both inputs open
uplink._note: 0x19 '0-20mA' frame. current = 0x6F86(28550) * 20 / 47584 = 12.0 mA. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (current.value=12 mA, logic_level [0,0]).

uplink.description: 4-20 mA low-alert frame: 9.60 mA input, input1 closed
uplink._note: 0x22 "Trame d'alerte BAS d'une valeur 4-20mA": span 16 mA, trailing offset byte. current = 0x6F86(28550) * 16 / 47584 = 9.6 mA. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (current.value=9.6 mA, logic_level [0,1]).

uplink.description: life frame: secondary rail 3.60 V -> battery (no positions, so no channels[])
uplink._note: 0x01 'Trame de vie': tensionc 0x0E10=3600 / 1000 = 3.6 V. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (tensionc.value=3.6). battery and frameType are whole-device readings and stay top-level.
0x42 is a DINDxx digital-inputs frame, not a DINDA analog frame.
